decisions.reason: Although it is less core than the plant business, the accelerator extends the firm's advisory and partnership capabilities and helps it absorb external knowledge from startups, while its continued home-page presence through 2024 signals strategic value.

The binder is an adjacent application of the firm's recycling and feedstock know-how, and with in-house R&D in a science-intensive German innovation setting the firm has a credible basis to refine and commercialize it, as suggested by its continued dedicated page in 2024.

This decontamination plant is very close to the firm's existing waste-treatment machinery capabilities and is supported by visible partner cooperation, so the firm is well placed to learn from early deployment and improve it commercially.

Even though it is close to the firm's core knowledge base, its disappearance from the website by 2024 suggests weak traction or a strategic deprioritization, so resources are better shifted to stronger adjacent products and core developments.
